prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Americium (Am) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: an all-night convenience store of her element's kingdom at three in the morning — bright shelves, a warm drinks cabinet and an empty street beyond the glass
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a store clerk look fitted to her body — a cropped uniform vest over a fitted crop top, a short pleated skirt, sneakers and a name tag, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing close to a high shelf or line, reaching up to it.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right arm reaches up, the hand on the shelf or line above her head — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEGS: rising onto her toes.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.
Scene note: she minds the night shift of the all-night store, the one light still on in the street

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — americium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first identified in late 1944, born on its own as plutonium-241 decays, and named for the Americas just as europium above it was named for Europe; a speck smaller than a grain of dust sits inside household smoke detectors, gently ionizing the air between two plates, and when smoke drifts in it notices and sounds the alarm; with a half-life of 432 years it is a tiny lamp that stays awake while everyone sleeps — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original kept; no recreation of an existing image
